China Purges Top Military Commanders Amid Anti-Corruption Drive

China has expelled a top People's Liberation Army (PLA) officer, Zhang Youxia, as part of an anti-corruption purge led by President Xi Jinping. This action has raised questions about the country's ability to wage war.
